item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q009_heme_bundle_fold_not_homology","answer":"No. In SCOPe 2.08 these are three distinct superfamilies within the same fold: Transmembrane di-heme cytochromes, f.21.1 (SUNID 81342); Fumarate reductase respiratory-complex transmembrane subunits, f.21.2 (SUNID 81343); and Respiratory nitrate reductase 1 gamma chain, f.21.3 (SUNID 103501). Their common parent is the Heme-binding four-helical bundle fold, f.21 (SUNID 81344), in class f. Sharing a fold supports architectural similarity, not the common ancestry asserted at superfamily level. Therefore SCOPe does not justify combining them into one homologous superfamily, transferring specific functions among them, or selecting a member of one superfamily as a homologous representative/template for another solely from this fold match. Any proposed cross-superfamily homology would require independent sequence, phylogenetic, or stronger structure-based evolutionary evidence; representatives should otherwise be chosen separately within f.21.1, f.21.2, and f.21.3.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info — /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__search_scop — /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=transmembrane+di-heme+cytochromes&mode=auto&limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=fumarate+reductase+respiratory+complex+transmembrane+subunits&mode=auto&limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=respiratory+nitrate+reductase+gamma+chains&mode=auto&limit=50","mcp__scope__get_scop_node — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.2; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/f.21.3"]}]}
